scripts.check: biome ci . && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tools && node tools/build/check-messages.ts && node tools/build/icons.ts && vitest run

scripts.test:e2e:live: EFS_CHAIN=live playwright test tests/e2e/edit tests/e2e/read-floor tests/e2e/versions tests/e2e/media tests/e2e/folders tests/e2e/folder-writes tests/e2e/a11y-files tests/e2e/tags tests/e2e/dev-accounts tests/e2e/mvp-tour --project=chromium
scripts.transcripts:record: EFS_CHAIN=record playwright test tests/e2e/edit tests/e2e/versions tests/e2e/media tests/e2e/folders tests/e2e/folder-writes tests/e2e/a11y-files tests/e2e/tags tests/e2e/budgets tests/e2e/dev-accounts tests/e2e/mvp-tour --project=chromium --workers=1
